title: Aarcade daily comms
summary: Own newsfeed + tweet-draft pipeline: a real Claude terminal on the iMac drafts, the Aarcade API publishes, tweets stay approve-gated.
autonomy: Daily at 23:50 America/Los_Angeles via the iMac crontab (`50 23 * * *`, installed by `abra run gotchibot -- ./scripts/gotchibot comms schedule install`), and whenever asked: run `abra run gotchibot -- ./scripts/gotchibot comms run` and relay the "Claude said (verbatim)" block word for word. `./scripts/gotchibot comms schedule status` is the only source of truth for whether the daily run is scheduled and when it last ran. Never post to X; never print secrets; never Commsies / Cloudflare AI.
